title: Binding Mechanism of Inhibitors to BRD4 and BRD9 Decoded by Multiple Independent Molecular Dynamics Simulations and Deep Learning.
authors: Wang, Jian; Yang, Wanchun; Zhao, Lu; Wei, Benzheng; Chen, Jianzhong
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD和深度学习研究抑制剂与BRD4/BRD9蛋白的结合机制，属于蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Bromodomain 4 and 9 (BRD4 and BRD9) have been regarded as important targets of drug designs in regard to the treatment of multiple diseases. In our current study, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, deep learning (DL) and binding free energy calculations are integrated to probe the binding modes of three inhibitors (H1B, JQ1 and TVU) to BRD4 and BRD9. The MD trajectory-based DL successfully identify significant functional function domains, such as BC-loop and ZA-loop. The information from the post-processing analysis of MD simulations indicates that inhibitor binding highly influences the structural flexibility and dynamic behavior of BRD4 and BRD9. The results of the MM-GBSA calculations not only suggest that the binding ability of H1B, JQ1 and TVU to BRD9 are stronger than to BRD4, but they also verify that van der Walls interactions are the primary forces responsible for inhibitor binding. The hot spots of BRD4 and BRD9 revealed by residue-based free energy estimation provide target sites of drug design in regard to BRD4 and BRD9. This work is anticipated to provide useful theoretical aids for the development of selective inhibitors over BRD family members.
abstract_zh: 溴结构域蛋白4和9（BRD4和BRD9）一直被视为多种疾病治疗中药物设计的重要靶点。在本研究中，我们整合了分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟、深度学习（deep learning, DL）及结合自由能计算，以探究三种抑制剂（H1B、JQ1和TVU）与BRD4和BRD9的结合模式。基于MD轨迹的深度学习成功识别了关键的功能结构域，如BC环和ZA环。MD模拟后处理分析的信息表明，抑制剂结合显著影响BRD4和BRD9的结构灵活性和动态行为。MM-GBSA计算的结果不仅表明H1B、JQ1和TVU与BRD9的结合能力强于与BRD4的结合，还验证了范德华相互作用是驱动抑制剂结合的主要力量。通过基于残基的自由能估算揭示的BRD4和BRD9热点区域，为针对BRD4和BRD9的药物设计提供了靶点。预期这项工作将为开发针对BRD家族成员的选择性抑制剂提供有用的理论支持。
